# Copilot instructions for this repo

This repository is a single-purpose content-generation workflow: given a movie/show title or a
film-commentary video URL, produce a deep commentary script plus an original animated short
screenplay.

The complete workflow, copyright rules, and output requirements live in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root. Read it in full and follow it whenever a request
matches what it describes, rather than improvising a different approach.
